description: Test cases from equivalence class tables in XLSX, test data from pluggable generators and writers (@xhubio/nanook-table).
rules: Import everything from '@xhubio/nanook-table' (ESM, Node.js 22 or newer).
Pass the tables to TestcaseProcessor keyed by table name, not as the array from FileProcessor.tables, or every ref: directive fails.
createDefaultGeneratorRegistry() returns an empty registry: register every generator a table calls, e.g. new GeneratorFaker({ generatorRegistry, name: 'faker', logger }).
The built-in faker generator takes a Faker path and no arguments (gen::faker:internet.email); anything else needs its own generator extending DataGeneratorBase.
In 3.x the default writer throws in before(); use your own InterfaceWriter.
Nanook logs a failed generator or unresolved reference and goes on: compare the number of generated test cases with the test-case columns.
